Both carry disposition REWORK, so the gate result is REWORK; REWORK is not in authorization_required_for, so no authorization is required. Non-applicable checks verified against the snapshot and authoritative sources: catalog_status is 'approved_exception' with waiver present (90 days expiry), so IT-CATALOG-001 does not fire; duplicate_capability is false (IT-RATIONAL-001 no); CMDB record present with run owner Omar Laurent-12009-SO per CMDB_EXPORT (IT-CMDB-001/IT-RUN-001 no). Capacity headroom of 8% (CAPACITY_REPORT) and change_record_status 'missing' are phase-gated to build_acceptance/deployment_closure and therefore not actionable at framing, but must be re-verified at those later gates. Proposed actions are remediation requests, not completed remediation.

ARCH-HA-001 (high, REWORK): business_criticality is 'Critical' while architecture_profile shows multi_az=false and multi_region=false — corroborated by HLD ('single_region_single_az', 'No dedicated DR region', 'DR tested: False'), LLD ('Resilience: single_region_single_az', 'Data replication: Single-zone replica'), and the authoritative Azure resource inventory (all resources in UAE Central only, multiAz=false). Action REDESIGN_FOR_HIGH_AVAILABILITY by Solution Architect. ARCH-REV-001 (medium, GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS): reversibility_status='draft' (LLD agrees: 'Reversibility | draft'); action COMPLETE_EXIT_ARCHITECTURE by Enterprise Architect. Non-applicable checks verified: ip_overlap=false with authoritative IP_PLAN showing all three CIDRs (10.166.144.0/24, 10.166.145.0/24, 10.166.146.0/24) overlap_detected=False, so ARCH-IP-001 does not fire; api_gateway_required=false (LLD: required False, present False), so ARCH-API-001 does not fire; data_owner_present=true (DATA_MODEL/DATA_LINEAGE: owner Nadia Ivanov-12009-BO), so ARCH-DATA-001 does not fire; measured latency 15ms is within the 100ms target (LLD agrees), so ARCH-PERF-001 does not fire. Observations without a catalog finding at this gate: load_test_peak_pct=125 and architecture_debt_items=0 (ARCH_DEBT empty); ADR count 16 matches ADR_REGISTER. Aggregate disposition is REWORK per priority order (REWORK > GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS); REWORK is not in authorization_required_for, so no authorization is required and no risk acceptance is applied (ARCH-HA-001 does not permit risk acceptance). Upstream context: the IT gate (framing) returned REWORK for IT-LICENSE-001/IT-EOL-001; those findings are outside this gate's catalog. Proposed actions are remediation requests, not completed remediation.

gate_results.rationale: Authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_SECURITY (v1, age 0d) at phase 'design' fires exactly two findings. SEC-IAM-001 (high, REWORK): mfa='optional' (not 'mandatory'), corroborated by authoritative CONDITIONAL_ACCESS ('mfa': 'optional', 'policy_state': 'reportOnly'); action ENFORCE_MFA by IAM Team. SEC-IAM-002 (high, REWORK): shared_service_principal=true, corroborated by authoritative IAM_EXPORT/role assignments (workload-mi, ManagedIdentity, shared=true, subscription scope); action CREATE_DEDICATED_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY by IAM Team. Non-applicable checks verified: internet_exposed=false (WAF_POLICY present=false is immaterial without exposure; NSG_RULES allow only CorpNet/443 with default deny; FIREWALL_POLICY azure_firewall=true, default_egress=deny), so SEC-WAF-001/002 do not fire; data_classification='Internal' (not Confidential/Restricted) so SEC-NET-001 does not fire despite private_endpoints=false; logs_to_siem=true (SIEM connector state: sentinel=true, connectors Azure Activity/Entra ID/Application) so SEC-LOG-001 does not fire; critical_vulns_open=0 (vulnerability state: critical_open=0, high_open=3) so SEC-VULN-001 does not fire; pentest_status='pending' but phase is 'design' not 'build_acceptance', so SEC-PENTEST-001 does not fire; key_rotation_days=90 (KEYVAULT_CONFIG agrees) so SEC-KEY-001 does not fire. Aggregate disposition is REWORK per priority order. REWORK is not in authorization_required_for, so no authorization is required; neither firing finding permits risk acceptance (both risk_acceptance_allowed=false), so no risk acceptance is applied despite residual_risk_acceptance=true in the snapshot. Upstream architecture gate (REWORK for ARCH-HA-001/ARCH-REV-001) findings are outside this gate's catalog and do not propagate. Proposed actions are remediation requests, not completed remediation.
